description: V12 with arrival-aware pressure at threshold 0.25, independent block safety, existing-block priority, HOLD pooling and WAIT safety conditioned on our first-action body occupancy. No pressure retry memory. Train from scratch against 1 rule_based_agent opponent(s) for 30000 rounds with Reward V5, world/agent seeds 21/20021, alpha 0.1 with visit-decay power 0.60, gamma 0.95 and sampled 5-step Q-learning. Epsilon reaches 0.05 after 22000 completed rounds. Checkpoints every 100 rounds retain canonical state-action update counts. Evaluate against the same roster on five held-out seed pairs, 200 rounds each, with existing diagnostics and no replays.
